From: Alex Hart <alex.hart@fincorp.com>

Date: 2027-10-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — narrow window request

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the earlier product notes — we're ready to move to a hands-on gating walkthrough. Our security team wants to accomplish three things in one meeting if possible: 1) map your SOC 2 controls to our requirements, 2) go over the DPA language and any data residency implications, and 3) validate pen-test logistics (scope + vendor access).

We have a tight calendar this week. Can you confirm whether you prefer a single 90-minute session or two 45-minute focused sessions (controls + DPA first, pen-test logistics second)? Our tentative availability (US Eastern):
  - Thu Nov 4: 15:00–16:30 ET
  - Fri Nov 5: 09:00–10:30 ET
  - Mon Nov 8: 18:00–19:30 ET (after-hours)

If you can share your preferred slot, we can lock it. Also:
  - We'll upload a small asset inventory and vendor contact to the secure bucket beforehand — preferred transfer is S3 presigned or shared Drive link.
  - We will need a redline-friendly DPA for review; if you can send a DocuSign link or draft, that helps us prep legal.
  - Please confirm which Redwood attendees should present (engineering for pen-test, security/product for controls).

I've attached a one-page asset inventory template to speed things up.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we need this in the next fortnight to keep procurement moving.

Best,
Alex Hart
Head of Security, FineCorp
security@fincorp.com

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — narrow window request

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the template. Laura (legal) and Irene (security ops) are looped. Quick replies inline below and a couple of asks: 

- Session format: we can do either. If you want to minimize context switching, one 90-minute session is doable; splitting into two 45s works better if you want separate vendor-only discussion for the pen test. Our recommendation: two 45-minute blocks back-to-back — that lets us bring the pen-test engineer for the second block only.

- Proposed slots (all times ET):
  1) Thu Nov 4 — 15:00–16:30 (we can split into 14:45 join / 15:00 start)
  2) Fri Nov 5 — 09:00–10:30
  3) Mon Nov 8 — 18:00–19:30 (we'll gate ops on call)

Any of those work for us; if you confirm "Fri Nov 5, two 45s", I'll send a calendar invite with two consecutive events (45 + 45) and include an ops bridge.

- Evidence transfer: we prefer a pre-shared Drive folder for docs (read-only) plus an SFTP token for sensitive artifacts. I've created a provisional Drive folder for this thread: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_fake_drive_link — please upload the asset inventory and any network diagrams there. If you prefer S3 presigned, let us know and we will provide a short-lived URL.

- DPA / legal: Laura, can you drop a redline-friendly DPA (DocuSign link) here? Laura: suggested approach: send the latest DPA + a short summary of any non-standard clauses to watch for.

- Pen-test vendor: if you have an external vendor, please share contact and scope — we will add them to the second block and produce vendor-runbook notes.

Attachments: SOC2_controls_summary.xlsx (internal stub)

If that works, I'll follow up with calendar invites and the call bridge.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
